data.title: horse/: BRANDING.md — Muybridge 'The Horse in Motion' slideshow direction (mobile landscape)

data.body: Requirements from user: horse/ is a new sub-site for the mobile LANDSCAPE slot. Design: a slideshow of the frames of Eadweard Muybridge's 'The Horse in Motion' (1878, public domain). Classic serif typography. Each slide/frame is a distinct link (its own URL — likely hash/:target given the static combined-page build). Tapping the right or left side advances one frame forward/back. Swiping plays the frames in sequence, animating the horse like a flipbook. Deliverable: horse/BRANDING.md; then generate the page via the brand-page skill per repo convention.

REVIEW (cold, agent:claude-fable-5-reviewer) — PASS with one trivial inline fix (9a40e27). Reviewed horse/BRANDING.md (commit 0c9f589) against the plan and the CLAUDE.md authoring contract. Findings: (1) All 10 decision areas from the plan are pinned concretely; structure/tone reads as a sibling of marble/liquid (laws, tokens, contrast table, recipes, 'what this is not', page application, the test). (2) Contract compliance verified: all ids horse--prefixed (frames, grain filter, keyframes); pointer listeners only on .stage inside root, no window/document handlers, anchor .click() instead of location APIs, :target read via querySelector not location.hash; @import URL semicolons %3B-encoded; :has() recipes comma-free; no display on html/body; no scroll container; registry-function JS shape + standalone boot lines correct. (3) Absolute-path claim /horse/frames.jpg verified against build.js: transformStatements only prefixes selectors and hoists @imports — no url() rewriting — so a relative path would break in the built root page; absolute is correct, and marble confirms prior sites hotlink (first local-asset site claim holds). (4) Contrast table recomputed independently — every value matches (6.66/7.81/5.21/12.26; 5.37/6.30/4.20/9.89; highlight fails as stated). Sprite background-position math (i-1)/(N-1) is correct for background-size N*100%. (5) Factual claims carefully hedged: frame count 'nominally 12' with mandatory verification against the real scan; PD status correctly grounded (1878 publication, Muybridge d. 1904); card caption text accurate. (6) Scope clean: commit adds only BRANDING.md + this task's lattice files; no page files, no sites.config.json/build.js/index.html edits. Inline fix applied (9a40e27): §5's .frame:first-of-type default rule silently fails if the JS playback layer precedes the slides in .stage — added a DOM-order footnote pinning the playback layer after the slides. Meets all acceptance criteria; moving to done.
